convert_parameters_to_vector: convert an iterable of model parameters into a single flattened vector tensor
convert_vector_to_parameters: copy slices from a parameter vector back into individual model parameters
flatten_parameters_for_serialization: flatten all model parameters into a single vector for serialization or transmission
restore_parameters_from_vector: restore model parameters from a flattened vector representation
validate_parameter_device_consistency: validate that all model parameters are on the same device before vector conversion
